name: vpd_dryness_factor
label: Atmospheric stress
description: Constant multiplier on the observed VPD over the whole simulation period. 1.0 = observed VPD; above 1 is drier air, below 1 is more humid air.

name: theta_moisture_factor
label: Soil moisture stress
description: Constant multiplier on the observed soil water content (theta), applied uniformly to every layer over the whole simulation period. 1.0 = observed theta; below 1 is drier soil, above 1 is wetter soil.

name: canopy_height
label: Canopy height
description: Plant/stand height.

name: k_xylem_sat
label: Xylem sat. conductivity
description: Saturated xylem hydraulic conductivity (typical range 0.5-10 kg m-1 s-1 MPa-1, Xu et al. 2016).

name: psi50_xylem
label: Xylem ψ₅₀
description: Xylem water potential at 50% loss of conductivity.

name: psi88_xylem
label: Xylem ψ₈₈
description: Xylem water potential at 88% loss of conductivity.

name: huber_value
label: Huber value
description: Sapwood-to-leaf area ratio (1/klatosa). Typical range 1/20000 to 1/2000.

name: stem_hydraulic_capacitance_max
label: Stem capacitance (max)
description: Maximum stem hydraulic capacitance (Meinzer et al. 2011, Fig 13.2; range 10-500 kg H2O m-3 MPa-1).

name: stem_hydraulic_capacitance_res
label: Stem capacitance (res)
description: Residual stem hydraulic capacitance (range 0-30 kg H2O m-3 MPa-1).

name: leaf_hydraulic_capacitance
label: Leaf capacitance
description: Leaf hydraulic capacitance (range 0.2-1.2, Blackman & Brodribb 2011; ~0.05, Xu et al. 2016).

name: g0
label: Min. stomatal conductance
description: Medlyn et al. 2011 model minimum/cuticular stomatal conductance g0 (residual conductance as photosynthesis approaches zero). Medlyn 2011: 0-0.05.

name: g1
label: Intrinsic water use eff.
description: Medlyn et al. 2011 model g1 slope parameter (stomatal sensitivity to VPD/assimilation). Medlyn 2011: 1.6-12.

name: psi_tlp
label: Turgor loss point
description: Leaf water potential at turgor loss.

name: psi_leaf_50_close
label: Stomatal closure ψ₅₀
description: Leaf water potential at which stomata close 50%. Evaluated once, typically at 5am.

name: d_50_close
label: Stomatal closure slope
description: Slope parameter of stomatal closure around psi_leaf_50_close. Must be positive.

name: root_area_index
label: Root area index
description: Total fine-root surface area per unit ground area (Katul et al.: 5.5-14.2).

name: soil_k_sat_log10
label: Soil sat. conductivity
description: Saturated soil hydraulic conductivity, applied uniformly to every soil layer. Log10-scaled: physically spans ~1e-9 (clay) to ~1e-3 (sand/gravel), too wide for a linear slider.

name: psi_soil_sat
label: Soil sat. water potential
description: Reference soil water potential at saturation, applied uniformly to every soil layer (Clapp 1978: -0.153 m).

name: theta_s
label: Saturated water content
description: Saturated volumetric soil water content, applied uniformly to every soil layer.

name: theta_r
label: Residual water content
description: Residual volumetric soil water content, applied uniformly to every soil layer.

name: pore_size_ind
label: Pore size index
description: Van Genuchten pore-size distribution index, applied uniformly to every soil layer.
